<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 134.10955) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈133.102 Da. The nitrogen rule indicates an odd number of nitrogens. A composition that matches this mass within a few ppm and contains one nitrogen is C₆H₁₅NO₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 133.110 Da, within acceptable tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C6H15NO2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H15NO2</final_answer>
